## Personal Clipper — Error Handler
Set this as the **Error workflow** of *Personal Clipper* (workflow Settings → Error workflow).
The Error Trigger only receives the workflow name, the failed node (= stage), the error message and the execution URL — not the workflow's data. The runner puts the stage, a human message and a `fix` hint into its error body, which n8n surfaces in `execution.error.message`; open the execution URL to see the input file / job_id.
Error workflows fire for production (trigger-started) executions only, not for manual test runs.
